title: Mannens datter og kjerringens datter
world: Old rural Norway, long ago. At home: a small grey log farmhouse with a turf roof, a round stone well in the long grass in front, and a tiny pig-house of rough grey planks with one small window. Deep down the well lies another world: a wide green meadow with a low fence of woven hazel twigs, a big old apple tree with a kind face in its bark, and a path to the troll hag's farm, a grassy mound with a round wooden door. Her one room is dug into the earth: stone walls, roots hanging from the ceiling, a thick beam, and a plank table with a candle and a bowl of mushrooms. Her low, dark cowshed holds three black cows. The three chests are small wooden chests with curved lids: one red, one green, and one blue with three little white crosses on its lid.
palette: Two worlds. At home above the well: a grey, damp day under low clouds, with wet grass and muted greens, browns and greys. Down below the well: a dreamlike, sunlit world of everlasting summer, with jewel-bright green grass, a big, soft white-gold sun in a cloudless apricot-tinted sky, white clover and red apples. In the troll hag's earth house: dim, earthy browns lit by one candle. At the end, the pig-house glows with warm gold and pearly light. Accents: the Girl's blue headscarf and the red, green and blue chests.

cast.name: Mannens datter
cast.description: En arbeidsom og snill jente som lytter, hjelper dem hun møter og finner kloke løsninger når oppgaver virker umulige.
cast.look: A kind, patient girl of about thirteen, slim and a little small for her age, with a narrow, gentle little face, big grey eyes, a tiny nose, pink cheeks and a shy smile. Her light-brown wavy hair curls to her shoulders from under a blue headscarf knotted at the nape of her neck. She wears a plain, patched undyed linen dress, a faded brown pinafore and old brown shoes.

cast.name: Kone-datteren
cast.description: Den late og sta stesøsteren som vil ha belønning uten å vise omsorg, og som ofte velger lettvint i stedet for snilt.
cast.look: A sturdy, broad-shouldered girl of about fourteen with a broad, square face, a heavy jaw, full lips pushed out in a sulk, a wide flat nose, small dark eyes under heavy black eyebrows drawn together in a scowl, and a big, bushy cloud of black frizzy hair tied on top with a red ribbon. She wears a fussy mustard-yellow dress with puffed sleeves and a ruffled white collar, shiny red shoes with buckles, and a small cloth pouch of raisins tied at her waist.
cast.portrait: Background: the grey farmhouse with the well in front.

cast.name: Stemoren
cast.description: Mannens nye kone og mor til Kone-datteren. Hun blir aldri fornøyd med Mannens datter og drømmer om vegger av gull.
cast.look: A short, stout, bossy woman of about forty-five with a big, doughy face, heavy cheeks, a small snub nose, small cold black eyes, a sour little mouth and frizzy black hair streaked with grey, bundled into a big knot on top of her head. She wears a stiff dark-plum wool dress with a black bodice and a starched collar fastened with a large round silver brooch, and she usually stands with her arms folded.
cast.portrait: Background: the grey farmhouse on a damp, cloudy day.

cast.name: Trollkjerringa
cast.description: En streng og smågretten gårdskone i den underjordiske gården som tester jentene med merkelige oppgaver, men lar dem dra med lønn til slutt.
cast.look: A big, heavy, barrel-shaped troll woman, a head taller than a grown woman and twice as broad, with a wrinkled, sallow face, a very long, knobbly, hooked nose, one thick bushy grey eyebrow straight across her forehead, small squinting black eyes, a sour down-turned mouth and a wart on her chin. Stiff grey hair pokes out of a red headscarf tied under her chin. She wears a coarse charcoal-grey dress, a sacking apron and huge, clumpy clogs, and a tufted cow's tail peeks out under her skirt.
cast.portrait: Background: her candlelit earth house with roots hanging from the ceiling.

cast.name: Småfuglene
cast.description: Små, hjelpsomme fugler som synger vennlige råd og viser hvordan tålmodighet og omtanke kan løse vanskelige oppgaver.
cast.look: A little flock of exactly three identical tiny songbirds, each no bigger than a plum: round and fluffy, with a sky-blue cap, wings and tail, a lemon-yellow breast, white cheeks with a thin black stripe through each eye, a short black beak, shiny black bead eyes and thin grey legs. They always stay together, sing with their beaks wide open and tilt their heads cheerfully.
cast.portrait: Background: the rim of a stone well in the sunshine.

cast.name: Kua
cast.description: Den snille kua på den grønne enga, med ei bøtte på hornene. Hun vil bli melket, og siden gjemmer hun Mannens datter under magen sin.
cast.look: A gentle, plump cow with a red-and-white spotted coat, long curved cream-coloured horns, big soft brown eyes with long lashes, a wet pink nose, a calm, friendly face, a swishing tail with a white tuft and pale hooves. A wooden milk bucket with a rope handle always hangs from one of her horns.

cast.name: Bukken
cast.description: En stor sauebukk med så mye ull at han ser ut som ei sky med bein. Han vil bli klipt, og siden gjemmer han Mannens datter under ullskjerfet sitt.
cast.look: A big, round sheep ram so thick with creamy-white wool that he looks like a cloud on legs, with a black face, black legs, big curly golden-brown horns, sleepy half-closed amber eyes and a soft, silly smile. A big pair of iron sheep shears hangs from one of his horns.

places.name: the Green Meadow
places.look: A wide, gently rolling meadow of the brightest, softest green grass, dotted with white clover, buttercups and daisies, under a big, soft white-gold sun. A narrow earth path winds across it past a low fence of woven hazel twigs and a big, old, gnarled apple tree whose branches bend to the ground under hundreds of red apples, with a gentle face in its bark: two knot-hole eyes and a smiling crack of a mouth. Far away, a grassy mound with a round wooden door.

cover.prompt: The Girl walks along the winding path through the sunlit Green Meadow, her blue headscarf fluttering, looking up with delight at the Little Birds, all three of them, fluttering around her head and singing. Beside the path stand the Cow with the bucket on her horn and the big, woolly Ram with the shears on his horn, both watching her kindly. Behind them rise the low fence of woven twigs and the old apple tree heavy with red apples.
cover.caption: Nede i brønnen ligger ei stor, grønn eng, og der kan både kua og bukken snakke.
cover.alt: Mannens datter går langs en sti på ei solfylt, grønn eng. Tre små fugler flyr rundt hodet hennes, og ved stien står ei ku med ei bøtte på hornet og en ullen bukk med ei saks på hornet.

illustrations.anchor: Et lite lam kom bort og snuste i kurven hennes.
illustrations.prompt: A grey, damp day. In the long wet grass beside the round stone well in front of the small grey farmhouse, the Girl and the Stepsister sit spinning with wooden hand spindles. The Stepsister has a basket of soft, silky, pale-gold flax and a smug face; the Girl has a basket of stiff, prickly black pig bristles. A little white lamb has trotted over to sniff the Girl's basket, and she strokes its head with a smile. Behind them, the Stepmother stands with her arms folded, frowning at the lamb.
illustrations.caption: Dyr likte Mannens datter. Det gjorde ikke stemoren.
illustrations.alt: Jentene sitter i gresset ved brønnen og spinner. Kone-datteren har en kurv med mykt lin, og Mannens datter har en kurv med stikkete bust. Et lite lam snuser på kurven, og stemoren står bak med armene i kors.

illustrations.anchor: Hun falt og falt og falt.
illustrations.prompt: Dump! The Girl has just landed softly on her bottom in the thick, soft grass of the Green Meadow. She sits with her hands in the grass and her blue headscarf a little askew, looking around in wide-eyed wonder. Around her the meadow glows jewel-green under a big, soft white-gold sun, and far off the path winds away past the low fence of woven twigs and the big apple tree. A wide view.
illustrations.caption: Dump! Hun landet mykt i det grønneste gresset hun noen gang hadde sett.
illustrations.alt: Mannens datter sitter i det grønneste gresset og ser seg forundret rundt. Enga er stor og grønn, og sola skinner.

illustrations.prompt: In the Green Meadow, the Girl has milked the Cow and drunk so much that she has a big white milk moustache on her upper lip. Grinning, she tips the wooden bucket and pours the last of the milk over the Cow's front hooves. The Cow turns her head and looks back at her with half-closed, contented eyes. A close, cheerful view in the warm sunshine.
illustrations.caption: Hun drakk til hun fikk melkeskjegg, og resten helte hun på klauvene.
illustrations.alt: Mannens datter har melket kua og drukket så hun har fått melkeskjegg. Nå heller hun resten av melka over klauvene til kua, som ser fornøyd ut.

illustrations.anchor: Bukken la seg i fanget hennes, og hun klippet.
illustrations.prompt: In the Green Meadow, the Girl sits in the grass with the big Ram lying across her lap, his eyes blissfully closed and his legs in the air. He is freshly sheared, with only a short, soft coat left, and fluffy tufts of wool lie all around them in the grass. The Girl is winding the last of the wool round his neck like a big, soft scarf, the iron shears laid down beside her and a small bundle of wool for herself.
illustrations.caption: Resten av ulla surret hun rundt halsen hans som et skjerf.
illustrations.alt: Den store bukken ligger nyklipt i fanget til Mannens datter med lukkede øyne. Hun surrer den siste ulla rundt halsen hans som et mykt skjerf.

illustrations.anchor: Trollkjerringa hadde lang nese, rødt skaut og et blikk som kunne få melk til å skjære seg.
illustrations.prompt: Inside the troll hag's single room dug into the earth: stone walls, roots hanging from the low ceiling, a thick beam, and a plank table with one candle and a bowl of mushrooms. The Troll Hag stands behind the table with her arms folded, glaring down her long, knobbly nose. In the round doorway, with sunny green daylight behind her, the Girl stands politely with her hands clasped, looking up at her bravely. Funny rather than frightening.
illustrations.caption: Trollkjerringa hadde et blikk som kunne få melk til å skjære seg.
illustrations.alt: Inne i en stue som er gravd inn i jorda, med røtter i taket og et lys på bordet, står trollkjerringa med rødt skaut og lang nese og glor. Mannens datter står pent i døra.

illustrations.anchor: Mannens datter klinte leire i soldet og stakk strå i hullene.
illustrations.prompt: At the stone well in front of the troll hag's grassy mound, the Girl carefully lifts a round wooden sieve with its bottom smeared with grey clay and little straws poked into the holes. Now it holds the water, brimming full without spilling a single drop, and she smiles in surprise. On the rim of the well sit the Little Birds, all three of them, singing with their beaks wide open. Bright sunshine.
illustrations.caption: «Klin i leire, stikk i strå!» sang småfuglene.
illustrations.alt: Ved brønnen løfter Mannens datter soldet, som er tettet med leire og strå, og nå holder det på vannet. På brønnkanten sitter tre små fugler og synger.

illustrations.anchor: Mannens datter sprutet en liten stråle melk bort til fuglene, og de drakk og kvitret.
illustrations.prompt: In the troll hag's low, dark cowshed with straw on the floor, three black cows stand as still and good as little lambs. The Girl sits on a milking stool beside the nearest cow and, laughing, squirts a thin stream of milk towards the small window, where the Little Birds, all three of them, sit on the ledge catching the drops in their open beaks. A beam of sunlight falls through the window.
illustrations.caption: «Liten streng, liten sup, til alle småfugler sprut!»
illustrations.alt: I fjøset sitter Mannens datter og melker, og kyrne står stille. Hun spruter en liten stråle melk bort til tre små fugler i vinduet, som drikker og kvitrer.

illustrations.anchor: Jo da: På lokket til det blå skrinet var det tre små kors.
illustrations.prompt: Inside the candlelit earth house, three small wooden chests stand in a row on the plank table: a red one, a green one and a blue one with three little white crosses on its lid. The Girl carefully lifts the blue chest with both hands. On the thick ceiling beam above her sit the Little Birds, all three of them, singing. On the other side of the table, the Troll Hag squints at her suspiciously with her arms folded.
illustrations.caption: «Ta ikke det grønne, ta ikke det røde, men ta det blå!»
illustrations.alt: På bordet står tre skrin: et rødt, et grønt og et blått. Mannens datter løfter forsiktig opp det blå skrinet med tre små kors på lokket. Oppe på bjelken synger småfuglene, og trollkjerringa myser.

illustrations.anchor: Mannens datter krøp inn, og greinene senket seg rundt henne som et grønt telt.
illustrations.prompt: In the Green Meadow, the big old apple tree, its branches now free of apples, has lowered its leafy branches all around the Girl like a green tent, and a neat pile of red apples lies at its roots. Only a glimpse of her blue headscarf and the blue chest shows between the leaves, and the tree's kind bark face gives a little wink. Far back along the path, the Troll Hag comes stomping towards the tree in her big wooden clogs, her red headscarf flapping.
illustrations.caption: Greinene senket seg rundt henne som et grønt telt.
illustrations.alt: Epletreet har senket greinene rundt Mannens datter som et grønt telt, så bare litt av det blå skautet hennes synes. Langt borte på stien kommer trollkjerringa trampende.

illustrations.prompt: In the Green Meadow, the Girl crawls in under the belly of the Cow, hugging the blue chest, snug and warm in the shade. The Cow stands squarely over her on four legs like posts, chewing innocently and gazing straight ahead as if nothing were there. In the distance, the Troll Hag comes stomping along the path again, her red headscarf flapping.
illustrations.caption: «Kryp inn under magen min», sa kua.
illustrations.alt: Mannens datter kryper inn under magen til kua med det blå skrinet. Kua står stille og tygger, og langt borte kommer trollkjerringa trampende.

illustrations.prompt: The low fence of woven hazel twigs has grown into a huge, tall, thick wall of crackling twigs, bristling angrily in every direction. On the near side stands the Troll Hag, small beside it, hands on her hips, glaring up at it past her long nose; she can neither climb over nor crawl under. On the far side, the Girl peeks out safely from a gap low down among the twigs, hugging the blue chest.
illustrations.caption: Gjerdet ble høyere og høyere, og tettere og tettere.
illustrations.alt: Gjerdet av kvister har vokst seg kjempehøyt og tett. På den ene siden står trollkjerringa med hendene i siden og glor, og på den andre siden titter Mannens datter trygt fram.

illustrations.prompt: Inside the little pig-house, scrubbed clean, gold and silver, pearls and lovely things spill out of the open blue chest and hang from the walls and ceiling, and a warm golden light fills the room so that it looks like a little palace. The Girl sits on a small stool beside the chest, glowing with happiness. In the doorway, the Stepmother and the Stepsister come running in and stop short, their eyes and mouths wide open.
illustrations.caption: Grisehuset ble fint som et lite slott.
illustrations.alt: Det åpne blå skrinet flommer over av gull, sølv og perler, og grisehuset skinner som et lite slott. Mannens datter sitter på en krakk, og i døra står stemoren og Kone-datteren og gaper.

illustrations.anchor: Kone-datteren klippet så fort og så skjevt at bukken så ut som en hekk etter storm.
illustrations.prompt: In the Green Meadow, the Stepsister clutches an enormous armful of wool under one arm with a greedy grin, the iron shears in her other hand. Beside her stands the Ram, looking utterly dismayed: he has been clipped so fast and so crooked that he looks like a hedge after a storm, with bald patches and tufts sticking out in every direction, and no scarf at all. Funny, not sad.
illustrations.caption: Bukken så ut som en hekk etter storm.
illustrations.alt: Kone-datteren står med armene fulle av ull og ei saks i hånda. Ved siden av står bukken, klipt så skjevt at han ser ut som en hekk etter storm.

illustrations.prompt: In the troll hag's low, dark cowshed, the biggest of the three black cows has just kicked over the milk bucket. The Stepsister sits on the straw floor with milk dripping from her frizzy hair and her ears and running all down her mustard-yellow dress, her mouth open in outrage. A broom lies where she threw it, and the Little Birds, all three of them, flutter away out of the small window. The cows look down calmly.
illustrations.caption: Der satt Kone-datteren med melk i håret og melk i ørene.
illustrations.alt: I fjøset sitter Kone-datteren på gulvet med melk i håret og nedover hele kjolen. Kua har sparket til bøtta, og småfuglene flyr ut av vinduet.

illustrations.prompt: In the grey farmhouse, beside the table, the red chest stands open on the floor, and out of it hops, crawls and wriggles a funny crowd of little green frogs, brown toads, pink worms and snails, all over the floorboards. The Stepmother stands frozen stiff with her arms in the air. The Stepsister has backed away and opened her mouth to shout, and out of it hops a little green frog. Funny, not scary.
illustrations.caption: For da hun åpnet munnen, hoppet det ut en liten frosk.
illustrations.alt: Det røde skrinet står åpent på gulvet, og frosker, padder, mark og snegler kryper utover. Stemoren står helt stiv, og ut av munnen til Kone-datteren hopper en liten frosk.

illustrations.anchor: Men Mannens datter bodde i grisehuset, som nå var finere enn et slott.
illustrations.prompt: A bright, sunny morning. Inside the little pig-house, now finer than a palace, the walls and ceiling shimmer with gold, silver and strings of pearls. The Girl leans on the sill of the open window with a happy smile, the morning sun on her face, and on the windowsill beside her sit the Little Birds, all three of them, singing their morning song. Outside, the grass sparkles with dew.
illustrations.caption: Hver morgen satte småfuglene seg i vinduet hennes og sang.
illustrations.alt: Grisehuset skinner av gull og perler i morgensola. Mannens datter lener seg i det åpne vinduet og smiler, og i vinduskarmen sitter tre små fugler og synger.
